main_turf.bias_notes: Right-handed (Clockwise). A spacious, undulating turf oval with a testing 400m home straight. The tracking geometry features sweeping right-handed turns that require high balance. The long straightaway ensures a fair finish, heavily favoring tactical pressers ('P') and closing swoopers ('C') who can save energy for the final uphill kick to the post.
main_turf.post_bias: In 1300m and 1600m starts, inside barriers (1-5) hold a clear statistical edge by ensuring a smooth, ground-saving tracking position into the first turn. Wide barriers (10+) face a severe penalty if trapped wide without cover on the turns.

handicapping_angles.undulating_stamina_filter: Vittel's natural rolling terrain acts as a severe stamina filter. Pure speed horses without proven distance limits tire quickly in the final 150 metres. Upgrade horses with verified closing sectionals over the distance.
handicapping_angles.penetrometer_moisture_shift: Always cross-reference the official France Galop penetrometer reading. On Soft/Heavy ground (Very Souple/Lourd), the track turns into a grueling test. Aggressively upgrade proven mud-track specialists and downgrade dry-turf speed types.
handicapping_angles.french_handicap_weight_impact: In standard French handicaps, weight carries a heavy tax over Vittel's undulating turf. Topweights carrying 60kg+ face a strict penalty against light-weight bottom types carrying 54kg or less (1kg = ~1 length). In local conditions races, prioritize pure class over weight spreads.
handicapping_angles.parisian_regional_shipper_angle: Keep a close eye on runners shipping in from premier Parisian training centers (Chantilly, Maisons-Laffitte) or major tracks (Compiègne, Saint-Cloud). Parisian class form lines carry a substantial class advantage over local regional provincial runners.
handicapping_angles.right_handed_balance_test: Vittel's sweeping right-handed bends demand exceptional cornering balance. Upgrade horses with a proven winning history on clockwise circuits and downgrade erratic left-handed specialists.
